verdict.rationale: First-party enterprise-readiness docs confirm a completed SOC 2 Type II audit and a HIPAA-compliant pipeline with a BAA for Enterprise customers. Self-hosting/BYOC and single-tenant options keep data under the customer's control, which covers medical-record and contract use cases. However, nothing documents a zero-retention policy for uploaded documents on the managed service, so that core element relies on self-hosting as a workaround. Missing for 10: explicit zero-data-retention handling for uploads, HIPAA available beyond the Enterprise tier, independent corroboration of the compliance claims.
